rules: 1. Remove FlooredNumber from the ./types import in packages/excalidraw/appState.ts.

Math.floor(appState.scrollX) : page.scrollX, scrollY: typeof appState.scrollY === "number" ? Math.floor(appState.scrollY) : page.scrollY, and zoom: appState.zoom ?? page.zoom.

value.behaviour: Scope History undo and redo stacks per page ID and file each recorded undo entry by the page of the elements it changes rather than the page active when Store commits.
rules: 1. Import getElementPageId from @excalidraw/element.

2. Add private getUndoStackForPage(pageId: string): HistoryDelta[] and private getRedoStackForPage(pageId: string): HistoryDelta[] helpers, and add private resolveDeltaPageId(delta: StoreDelta): string that inspects delta.elements.added, delta.elements.updated, and delta.elements.removed in order (resolving pageId from entry.inserted?.pageId ?? entry.deleted?.pageId ?? this.store.snapshot.elements.get(id)?.pageId and returning getElementPageId({ pageId })), then inspects selectedElementIds in delta.appState.delta against this.store.snapshot.elements, and falls back to this.activePageId only when no element is referenced.

3. In record(delta: StoreDelta), resolve const targetPageId = this.resolveDeltaPageId(delta); push historyDelta onto this.getUndoStackForPage(targetPageId); and when !historyDelta.elements.isEmpty(), clear this.getRedoStackForPage(targetPageId).

sites.rule: Add getUndoStackForPage, getRedoStackForPage, and resolveDeltaPageId, and file recorded historyDelta entries into the undo stack of the page whose elements the delta changes.

value.behaviour: Restore and normalize multi-page AppState and element pageId properties with backward-compatible legacy fallback, cross-page binding sanitization, and clean TypeScript types.
rules: 1. Remove FlooredNumber from the ../types import in packages/excalidraw/data/restore.ts.

2. In restoreAppState, set const rawPages = _appState ? appState.pages : localAppState?.pages; and const rawActivePageId = typeof appState.activePageId === "string" && appState.activePageId.trim() ? appState.activePageId.trim() : !_appState && typeof localAppState?.activePageId === "string" && localAppState.activePageId.trim() ? localAppState.activePageId.trim() : undefined; so importing a legacy single-page payload when localAppState has multiple pages synthesizes the single default page.

3. Type rawPage in the rawPages loop as Partial<ExcalidrawPage> & { zoom?: ExcalidrawPage["zoom"] | number } | null | undefined, extract rawZoomValue = isFiniteNumber(rawPage.zoom) ? rawPage.zoom : typeof rawPage.zoom === "object" && rawPage.zoom !== null && isFiniteNumber(rawPage.zoom.value) ? rawPage.zoom.value : defaultAppState.zoom.value, and remove all as FlooredNumber casts.

value.behaviour: Fix TypeScript types on page actions and mark deleted page elements as tombstones with bumped versions in actionDeletePage so collaborators delete them too.
rules: 1. Remove the invalid import from @excalidraw/common/types; instead import { CaptureUpdateAction, getElementPageId, newElementWith } from "@excalidraw/element" and import type { ExcalidrawPage, NormalizedZoomValue } from "../types".

2. In actionSwitchPage, actionCreatePage, actionRenamePage, actionReorderPages, and actionDeletePage, omit parameter type annotations on perform(elements, appState, value, app) so perform is assignable to ActionFn, and use plain numbers 0 instead of 0 as FlooredNumber.

3. In actionDeletePage, instead of filtering deleted page elements out of the array, map app.scene.getAllElementsIncludingDeleted() so every element where getElementPageId(el) === targetPageId && !el.isDeleted is replaced with newElementWith(el, { isDeleted: true }) (marking it deleted with a bumped version), and save the active page's current scrollX, scrollY, and zoom into remainingPages when deleting a non-active page.
